title: bridge: add diff and cockpit methods to wasm bindings 🌉
summary: Added run_diff and run_cockpit to the tokmd-wasm export boundary, closing a drift gap with tokmd-node and tokmd-python. Both modes are already implemented in tokmd-core and just needed to be exported idiomatically via wasm-bindgen.
proof_summary: wasm-bindgen cleanly exports runDiff and runCockpit, and compiles successfully under --features cockpit.
